title: Business Spaces directory: one search box that also reads tagline, city and subject, no repeated Spaces, notices and sign-up prompts
detail: Follow-up to LIVE-1018. The Frequency page drew two search bars (MarketHero's and the find row); the hero now takes no search under Frequency and the find row holds the one FqFindField, as Circles does. The discovery search matched only name, brand and slug; it now also reads tagline, city and the subject doors whose label holds the words. The All Spaces grid no longer repeats the Featured and Founding rows (it reads More Spaces while they show). Empty and no-match states are SystemNotice with a way forward, signed-out visitors get a sign up and log in notice at the top, and Create a Space appears once (the header, for members). No migration.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];const d=fs.readFileSync('lib/spaces/discovery.ts','utf8');for(const t of ['tagline.ilike','city.ilike'])if(!d.includes(t))bad.push('search lost '+t);const b=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/members/spaces/spaces-body.tsx','utf8');for(const t of ['FqFindField','SystemNotice'])if(!b.includes(t))bad.push('body lost '+t);const s=fs.readFileSync('lib/spaces/directory-sections.ts','utf8');if(!s.includes('leadIds'))bad.push('results repeat the lead rows');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1076: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the directory search stops reading tagline and city, the body loses its one find field or notices, or the grid repeats the lead rows.
